text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: (...Somehow, I kind of figured as much.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(The fire that kept these legs moving is 
surely... no longer here.)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, My body feels... like lead...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: “Still...! Even so—!”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh, uuu! Waaaahhhhhh--!!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I... could have won...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa has pulled off a brilliant 
victory in the Japan Cup...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...However.

text_block_list.name: Medical Staff
text_block_list.text:
There are no external injuries. Her bones 
and muscles are fine, too. Most likely... 
she simply pushed herself past her current 
limits.

text_block_list.name: Medical Staff
text_block_list.text:
If you rest for a while, you will be able 
to resume training and the like. However, 
a fundamental recovery... might prove 
difficult.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...? ...—Where is this?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "...I see. Overheating..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I ended up causing you to 
worry.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Actually... while running, I felt it. 
Whatever it was that kept my body moving 
has completely vanished.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"And so... I pushed myself too hard and 
collapsed after the race. In other words, 
that right there is my current—"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...The breaking point.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
(All this time... I was enveloped in such 
immense warmth, wasn't I?)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
... If that's what was asked of me, I 
wanted to run.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Deep down in my chest, my heart leaped for 
the first time in a while.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That... summer calm in my heart was merely 
temporary, and responding to the light 
everyone lit is my new duty—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I got my hopes up, just a little.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Still.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: But... gah—

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: I suppose... it really is time to bow out.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...At the very least, for the Arima 
Kinen, I want to run with all my gratitude 
to everyone."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Orfe-san, Buena-san... Rose-san, 
Ruler-san, Flash-san. It's going to be an 
illustrious lineup."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Victory... might be difficult to reach. 
Still, I want to challenge it with every 
ounce of strength I have.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Would you mind keeping me company for 
just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I couldn't find the right words.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, nothing could change the final 
race.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry. I've really been... putting you 
through so much harshness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I shook my head. The one suffering the 
most was, without a doubt, her."
choice_data_list:
...Let's give it our all, together until 
the very end.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —Phew, haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Such beautiful stars...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Just like the lanterns... from that 
day.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: —Haa, phew.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The days leading up to the Arima Kinen 
passed quietly by.
